decisions.quote:
Analyst success criteria: That all criteria meet Precise Reproduction Criteria.
Reproduction outcome: Based on these criteria, the claim did not reproduce.
Discussion: Secondary outcomes reproduced almost precisely ([2] pass rate estimates col(4) would be an approximate reproduction).
decisions.reason: After fixing file paths, syntax, and Stata package calls (and adding a school ID clustering variable to display the number of schools), the analyst reproduced Figure 3b and Table 4 across all three evaluated claims (6rr1l5, w7713v, and ppp6n8), explicitly noting in the Transparency Trail that 'Table 4 was reproduced at this point so this is the final analysis.' Claim w7713v was marked 'did not reproduce' strictly under the pre-selected 'Precise Reproduction Criteria' because column (4) was 0.0535 versus 0.053 in the original table (while column 3 was -0.0921 vs -0.092 and column 5 was 0.0678 vs 0.068, with identical sample size N = 717). Under the codebook, fourth-decimal rounding and negligible numerical differences, as well as script repairs needed to obtain the numbers, are coded as 'computationally reproducible' rather than 'computational issues'.
